name: Tametraline
summary: Tametraline (CP-24,441) is the parent of a series of chemical compounds investigated at Pfizer that eventually led to the development of sertraline.

pharmacology.text: 1R-Methylamino-4S-phenyl-tetralin is a potent inhibitor of norepinephrine uptake in rat brain synaptosomes, reverses reserpine induced hypothermia in mice, and blocks uptake of 3H-Norepinephrine into rat heart. Tametraline is a norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: Tametraline (CP-24,441) is the parent of a series of chemical compounds investigated at Pfizer that eventually led to the development of sertraline.

summaryZh: 他美曲林，化學名1R-甲基氨基-4S-苯基-四氫萘，是輝瑞公司研究的一系列化合物的母體，這些化合物最終促成了舍曲林的開發。
summaryZhHans: 他美曲林，化学名1R-甲基氨基-4S-苯基-四氢萘，是辉瑞公司研究的一系列化合物的母体，这些化合物最终促成了舍曲林的开发。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. As a noradrenaline and dopamine reuptake inhibitor, it would be expected to cause stimulant effects such as a racing heart, raised blood pressure, poor sleep and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作為正腎上腺素與多巴胺再回收抑制劑，預期它會造成心跳加速、血壓上升、失眠與焦慮等興奮作用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作为正肾上腺素与多巴胺再回收抑制剂，预期它会造成心跳加速、血压上升、失眠与焦虑等兴奋作用。

fact.en: Pfizer chemists started from tametraline and kept adjusting it. Adding two chlorine atoms and changing the 3D shape of the molecule led them to sertraline (Zoloft), one of the world's most prescribed antidepressants.
fact.zh: 輝瑞的化學家以他美曲林為起點不斷修改。加上兩個氯原子並改變分子的立體形狀後，他們得到了舍曲林（樂復得），這是全世界處方量最大的抗憂鬱藥之一。
fact.zhHans: 辉瑞的化学家以他美曲林为起点不断修改。加上两个氯原子并改变分子的立体形状后，他们得到了舍曲林（乐复得），这是全世界处方量最大的抗忧郁药之一。
